pedidos.instruccion_en: Apply a 28% gaussian blur only to the word 'amua' at the top of the yellow bottle label, so it looks clearly softened but still faintly legible. Keep everything else exactly the same: the 'VITALDROPS' name and the rest of the label sharp, the bottle, hand, woman, beach, headline, 'mi secreto' badge, comment box, layout, colors and all texts unchanged.
pedidos.resumen: Difuminamos al 28 % la palabra «amua» del frasco; todo lo demás queda igual.
